title: Fountain of Mercy, God of Love
description: Fountain of Mercy, God of Love in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 877 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Same”, where the book credits them to the Christian Psalmist.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Foun-tain of mer-cy, God of love, How rich thy boun-ties are! The roll-ing sea-sons, as they move, Pro-claim thy con-stant care.

lines: Fountain of mercy, God of love,
The rolling seasons, as they move,
When in the bosom of the earth
Thy goodness marked its secret birth,
The spring's sweet influence, Lord, was thine
Thou gav'st refulgent suns to shine,
A kindly harvest crowns thy love,
We own and bless thy gracious sway;
Seed-time nor harvest, night nor day,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
